name: Chennai Super Kings
description: The Chennai Super Kings are one of the most successful franchises in world cricket, renowned for disciplined execution, fierce loyalty, and five championship titles.

name: Delhi Capitals
description: Representing the national capital territory, Delhi Capitals boast a dynamic blend of Indian young talent and international power hitters.

name: Gujarat Titans
description: Based out of the world's largest cricket stadium in Ahmedabad, Gujarat Titans clinched championship glory in their inaugural season.

name: Kolkata Knight Riders
description: Hailing from the historic Eden Gardens, KKR are three-time champions celebrated for their aggressive cricket culture and global brand identity.

name: Lucknow Super Giants
homeGround: Bharat Ratna Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ekana Cricket Stadium
description: Playing at the grand Atal Bihari Vajpayee Ekana Stadium in Lucknow, LSG represent the heartland of North India with high-octane tactical brilliance.

name: Mumbai Indians
description: Five-time champions Mumbai Indians have established a legacy of scouting brilliance, tactical innovation, and unmatched silverware at Wankhede.

name: Punjab Kings
homeGround: Maharaja Yadavindra Singh International Cricket Stadium
description: The proud voice of the north, Punjab Kings bring fearless spirit, aggressive batting arsenals, and deep community support across Punjab.

name: Rajasthan Royals
description: The inaugural champions of 2008, Rajasthan Royals are pioneers in moneyball analytics, fearless powerplay hitting, and royal heritage.

name: Royal Challengers Bengaluru
description: Backed by one of the most passionate fanbases in global sports, RCB command Chinnaswamy Stadium with electrifying entertainment and explosive batting.

name: Sunrisers Hyderabad
description: Sunrisers Hyderabad are revered for record-shattering power batting, lethal bowling attacks, and relentless aggressive brand of T20 play.

name: Destroyers Cricket Club
homeGround: Divisional Cricket Stadium, Neem Chauraha / APSU Stadium
description: The reigning three-time champion powerhouse of the Atal Bihari Vajpayee Memorial Tournament, captained by premier all-rounder Pranav Dwivedi.

name: Dread Eleven Cricket Club
homeGround: Martand School Ground No. 3 / Neem Chauraha Stadium
description: The fierce arch-rivals of Destroyers CC, captained by top-order talisman Akhil Mishra with an unrelenting athletic brutalist identity.
